Glutathione Cream Price in India: How to Compare Value per Gram

Glutathione cream price in India varies a lot, from small budget jars to premium creams that cost a few thousand rupees. The sticker price alone tells you very little. The fair way to compare is the price per gram, and then what else is in the jar besides glutathione.

This guide explains the usual price levels in general terms, how to work out cost per gram and per month, what pushes the price up, and our own Mirc Glow prices so you can compare clearly.

Glutathione cream price in India: the usual levels

Prices change often and differ from seller to seller, so take these as broad levels you will see when you shop, not fixed rules:

LevelWhat you usually seeWhat to check
BudgetSmall jars, often under ₹500; glutathione may be one of many minor ingredientsIs glutathione listed high up, or near the end?
Mid-rangeLarger jars with glutathione plus one or two supporting actives such as vitamin C or niacinamideFull ingredient list, size in grams, batch and expiry
PremiumMulti-ingredient creams with several actives, more research-led formulas or imported jarsWhether you need every ingredient, and the price per gram

A higher price does not always mean more glutathione or better results. Some of it can go on packaging, advertising or import costs. Equally, a very cheap jar making big promises deserves a second look.

How to work out price per gram

Divide the price by the grams in the jar. For example, ₹1,499 ÷ 30 g is about ₹50 per gram. Now you can compare a 15 g jar and a 50 g jar fairly.

Then think per month. A pea-sized amount for the face plus a little for the neck is roughly 0.3–0.5 g a night, so most people use about 10–15 g a month. At ₹50 per gram, that is about ₹500–₹750 a month.

Also check whether the size is in grams or millilitres. Creams are usually sold by weight, and ml is close but not the same.

What makes a glutathione cream cost more

  • Supporting actives. Vitamin C, niacinamide, alpha arbutin or hyaluronic acid all add cost.
  • Stability. Glutathione and vitamin C can break down with air and light, so better jars and airtight packaging cost more.
  • Jar size. Small jars often look cheap but cost more per gram.
  • Brand and import costs. These raise the price without changing what you put on your face.

If you want to understand what glutathione can and cannot do before spending, read our glutathione cream benefits guide. The short version: it is an antioxidant for a brighter-looking, more radiant finish, and it does not change your natural skin colour.

Buying glutathione cream online: what to check

  • A full ingredient list, with glutathione named clearly.
  • Batch number, manufacturing date and expiry printed on the pack.
  • Sealed packaging, and a return policy for sealed jars.
  • Honest wording. Be careful with promises to change skin colour or show results in a few days.
  • Cash on Delivery if you are buying from a brand for the first time.

From us, delivery is free and usually takes 3–7 days, you can pay by Cash on Delivery or an online payment link, and sealed jars can be returned within 7 days. You can also order on WhatsApp at +91 99808 81230.

Getting your money's worth

The most expensive part of any cream is the jar you stop using after two weeks. A few habits make it last and work better:

  • Use a pea-sized amount; more does not mean faster.
  • Apply it at night on clean skin. Our guide on how to use glutathione cream shows the steps.
  • Wear sunscreen every morning, or the sun undoes the brighter look.
  • Give it 8–12 weeks before judging. See how long glutathione cream takes to work.
  • Patch test first, and read about glutathione cream side effects if your skin is sensitive.

Short answers

What is the price of glutathione cream in India? It ranges from budget jars under ₹500 to premium creams costing a few thousand rupees; compare them by price per gram.

How much does Mirc Glow Glutathione Cream cost? ₹1,499 for 30 g, about ₹50 per gram, with free shipping.

Is an expensive glutathione cream better? Not automatically. Check the ingredient list and price per gram rather than the sticker price.

How long does a 30 g jar last? About 6 to 8 weeks with a pea-sized amount every night, a little longer if you use it on the face only.

Can I pay cash on delivery? Yes. Mirc Glow offers Cash on Delivery or an online payment link across India.
